title: Momus
description: Since the 1980s, Momus has released what he calls "electronic folk music" on select independent labels such as él, Creation, and Cherry Red. The Scottish-born artist is also the author of several works of speculative fiction and a performance artist known for unreliable tours and emotionally charged presentations. His latest album is titled Mannequin (American Patchwork, 2026). An event as part of the 27th Karlsruhe Museum Night. Admission to the concert is free. DJ set by 1714e19 from 8 pm; concert at 10 pm.
